# Reuters

> > Reuters delivers breaking world news, financial markets data, and investigative journalism through digital platforms and mobile applications.

Reuters is a global news organization operated by Thomson Reuters, providing real-time news coverage, market updates, and multimedia content across business, finance, politics, technology, and world events. The Reuters mobile app offers personalized news feeds, push notifications, and podcast access for iOS devices.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news and global coverage
- Financial markets and economic data
- Reuters News App
- Thomson Reuters Enterprise Centre
- Personalized news feeds
- Push notifications
- Market updates and analysis
- Investigative journalism
- Podcasts and multimedia
- Subscription services
- iOS applications (iPhone/iPad)
- Real-time reporting

## Mobile Applications

- [Reuters - Breaking World News App](http://app.reuters.com/): Official Reuters mobile app for iOS devices delivering breaking news, personalized feeds, market updates, push notifications, and podcast access
